summary: Clinuvel Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K attaching an ASX announcement dated September 8, 2026, disclosing completion of development of ZEROKIN, a proprietary single-use subcutaneous administration device for controlled-release formulations. No transaction, stake, price, or board recommendation is involved; the device targets Class II FDA 510(k) registration and EU CE marking, with an IP application submitted and a commercial manufacturer to be appointed. This is a routine product-development disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms, overhang, or arbitrage angle apply.
